t: This is the Horse Hospital, a Grade II listed independent arts venue at Colonnade in Bloomsbury. Today it focuses on counter-cultural histories, sub-cultures, outsiders and emerging artists, with underground film screenings and exhibitions. Roger K. Burton founded it in 1992, and it opened with Vive Le Punk!, a retrospective of Vivienne Westwood's punk designs. The building is linked to James Burton, the most successful property developer of Regency and Georgian London, who built over three thousand properties across 250 acres, and spent over £400,000 on the Foundling Hospital Estate alone.
